scope: Current pond/violet collecting grounds and inherited courtyard; natural coast and sparse-to-grown resource display. No extra paths or weather.

technical_frame.camera: two-dimensional world offset; same world coordinates as field model
technical_frame.source_modification: Two new original opaque PNG material tiles copied byte-for-byte from built-in image_gen. No pixel editing, cropping, resizing or postprocessing. Runtime normal repeat maps each full tile to 512 by 512 world pixels; old painted-scene crops and mirrored/four-way sampling were removed.
technical_frame.shader_sampling: One texture(TEXTURE, world_position / 512 + flow) sample directly in fragment(). CanvasItem texture_repeat is enabled. No custom sampler helper or mirrored/cropped samples.

geometry_contract: Version 0.29 uses the same authored coast polygon for collision and core turf drawing. The accepted five-node tree is retained. Its outline is equally resampled, smoothed and shaped into varying-width banks and shallow bays. Three low-opacity 5/11/18px banks form a soft soil lip. Six uneven rooted foliage groups leave open stretches. Disabled potential resource sites and feedback are hidden.

flower.bud: curved attached stem with monotonic controls, basal leaves and expanding green-tinted head; deterministic ID-based size/height variation
flower.ripe: open painted head, nectar glint and collection arc; fixed ID-based size/height variation
flower.fading: brown droop/shrink and falling petals, still collectable
flower.empty: root leaves and growing shoot, no nectar

material.bud: fiber seed head or resin on rooted woody twig gradually forms
material.ripe: full fiber head / resin on bark, hit marks when nearby
material.fading: weathered fiber head / resin; dropped items show expiry arc

feedback: existing bee wing animation and harvest lean
directional pulse lines and pod recoil
falling drop bounce and pickup motes

approval.direction: Reuses the existing approved hand-painted garden family; source records retain their own historical acceptance/rights status.
approval.new_composition: Tile source inspection passed for object-free, low-contrast material appearance; native full-map review and runtime checks pending. Direction approval is inherited, not final player acceptance.

assets.use: violet flower head / distant pond fountain
curved attached flower and material stems
rooted foliage on closed shore inside actual turf; distant landmarks outside route
fiber icon inside attached pod / dropped pickup
solid resin on attached woody twig / dropped pickup
bee bag attached by straps, inherited courtyard inventory

feedback_revision: Two native passes rejected old scene-crop tiling due to visible plants, mirrors and grids. Exactly two purpose-made object-free tiles generated; normal 512px world repeat replaces all scene crop sampling. Soft banks, inside-bank roots and monotonic stems retained. User rejected rigid monotonous shores and dense initial resource sites. 0.29 replaces actual boundary and scatters potential flower positions; resource growth becomes two paid ranks.

generation_calls.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE square seamless repeating 2D game GROUND TEXTURE, opaque, flat overhead view. Subtle fine grass fiber strokes only. Seamlessly tileable on all four edges with even hue and density, no border, no seams, no vignetting, no central motif. Absolutely NO leaves, NO leaf clusters, NO bushes, NO flowers, NO big grass tufts, NO moss islands, NO roots, NO rocks, NO path, NO road, NO shore, NO objects, NO characters, NO text, NO UI, NO shadows of plants, NO mirrored patterns, NO checkerboard, NO large clumps. Do not draw a repeating tile preview; output only the single full-bleed square material texture. Prefer 1024x1024 output.
